visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with short black bangs and two braids sits at a light-colored wooden dining table. She holds a long, cream-colored, flexible object against her upper lip, pretending it is a mustache. She looks directly at the camera with wide eyes and a focused expression. The background is brightly lit by a large window with white curtains. (2) The girl shifts the cream-colored object, attempting to balance it on her head like a headband. Her hands are small and dexterous as she manipulates the item. She smiles broadly, revealing a joyful and playful mood. Variety-style subtitles appear frequently at the bottom of the frame to emphasize her cute actions. (3) The scene transitions to the girl now wearing a black, paper-cut stylized mustache taped to her upper lip. She peers into an off-screen mirror, her expression turning from curiosity to a slight grimace as she feels the adhesive. An adult's hand is visible occasionally, assisting her with the prop. (4) The camera perspective shifts to a high-angle POV looking down at the floor. The girl is seen crawling and reaching up for a hug from the cameraperson. She is wearing her red and white striped t-shirt and floral-patterned shorts. Her expression is one of pure affection and playfulness. (5) The video transitions to a final graphic screen with a solid pink background. A small cartoon character resembling the girl is centered above the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'. The lighting is flat and the composition is minimalist, signaling the end of the vlog segment.
